title: Which of these artists have designed a card in the set Coldsnap, Jeremy Jar
question:
Which of these artists have designed a card in the set Coldsnap, Jeremy Jarvis, Aaron Miller or Chippy?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: card set Coldsnap refers to name = 'Coldsnap'; Jeremy Jarvis, Aaron Miller or Chippy are the name of artists which refers to artist IN ('Jeremy Jarvis', 'Aaron Miller','Chippy');

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.XCL_002
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON c.XCL_063 = s.XCL_099
WHERE s.XCL_108 = 'Coldsnap'
  AND c.XCL_002 IN ('Jeremy Jarvis', 'Aaron Miller', 'Chippy')
